1) Composition according to Claim 1 wherein the compound of formula I is __an indole derivative__ and/or a physiologically acceptable salt thereof. (Currently amended)

3) Composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1 or 2, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of __0.00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight__. (Currently amended)

5) Composition according to claim 5, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient __at least one__ ectoine, preferably in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight, more preferably 0.1 to 5 per cent by weight and especially 0.1 to 2 per cent by weight. (Currently amended)

7) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition __for skin treatment__. (Currently amended)

8) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the preparation of a composition which is suitable for the prophylaxis and/or treatment of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation, in particular for the treatment of __acne and other skin conditions__. (Currently amended)

10) Use the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the care, preservation or improvement of the general state of the skin or hair, __including prophylaxis against skin conditions__. (Currently amended)

12) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 or 2 for skin lightening and/or skin whitening __in individuals with uneven skin tone__. (Currently amended)

13) Use the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the prophylaxis against or reduction of skin unevenness, such as __wrinkles, fine lines, and rough skin__. (Currently amended)

14) Use the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the prophylaxis against time- and/or light-induced ageing processes of the human skin or human hair, in particular for prophylaxis against __dry skin and wrinkle formation__. (Currently amended)
